newsitem.title: UK: Ladbroke buys betting chain for 31 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Ladbroke buys betting chain for 31 mln stg.

text.p: British hotel and betting company Ladbroke Group Plc said on Monday that it has bought the privately owned A R Dennis betting shop chain for 31.3 million stg in cash.
A R Dennis operates a chain of 114 betting shops in London and the South East of England.
Ladbroke said in a statement that as a result of the acquisition, Ladbroke Racing part of its betting and gaming division, will have 1,925 outlets.
It added that the purchase price might be increased by a maximum of 1.4 million stg based upon the performance of the business during the next twelve months.
"The shops represent a very good strategic fit with our existing business," said Christopher Bell, managing director of Ladbroke Racing.
